sources.excerpt:
# Shipping

Northstar Bikes ships only within the contiguous United States.

Standard shipping costs $8 and takes 3–5 business days. Orders of $100 or more qualify for free standard shipping.

Northstar Bikes does not offer expedited or international shipping.

Northstar Bikes accepts returns of unused bikes and accessories within 30 days of delivery.

Contact support before sending a return. Refunds are issued within 5–10 business days after the return is approved. Customers pay return shipping for nondefective items. Northstar Bikes provides free return shipping for defective items.

# Support and warranty

Contact Northstar Bikes at support@northstar.example. Support is available Monday through Friday, 09:00–17:00 UTC.

Bikes include a 2-year manufacturing warranty. The warranty does not cover ordinary wear or damage from crashes.

sources.excerpt:
# Shipping

Northstar Bikes ships only within the contiguous United States.

Standard shipping costs $8 and takes 3–5 business days. Orders of $100 or more qualify for free standard shipping.

Northstar Bikes does not offer expedited or international shipping.

Northstar Bikes accepts returns of unused bikes and accessories within 30 days of delivery.

Contact support before sending a return. Refunds are issued within 5–10 business days after the return is approved. Customers pay return shipping for nondefective items. Northstar Bikes provides free return shipping for defective items.

# Support and warranty

Contact Northstar Bikes at support@northstar.example. Support is available Monday through Friday, 09:00–17:00 UTC.

Bikes include a 2-year manufacturing warranty. The warranty does not cover ordinary wear or damage from crashes.
